scientific_integrity: All theorems are proved from explicit conditional independence and standard ergodicity facts; finite checks supplement the analytic proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to independent refresh noise on the full bilateral interval shift and not arbitrary nonlinear systems.
Every positive refresh rate produces infinite Kolmogorov--Sinai entropy and does not conserve original entropy.
Uniform cylinder bounds imply null infinite dynamical balls but are not asserted as equality for finite-time Bowen balls.
Equivalent earlier stationary-channel constructions may exist beyond sources inspected.
title: Sharp stationary refresh regularization for the Hilbert-cube shift
